description: Four buffers that each delay a polyphonic signal by a chosen number of whole samples

params.text: Sets the delay for that buffer, 1 to 9 samples, starting at 5

inputs.text: The signal that buffer delays, polyphonic

outputs.text: That buffer's input, delayed by the number of samples set on its knob

notes: the four buffers are separate from one another, so patch one output into the next input for more than nine samples of delay
